name: arnold
label: Arnold
about: Autodesk Arnold, through arnold-usd (husk with HdArnold, kick, usdview). Arnold's options are written as arnold:global: attributes on the RenderSettings prim, with the option's own name after the prefix.

params.name: arnold:global:AA_samples
params.label: Camera (AA)
params.help: Anti-aliasing samples: the square of this many camera rays per pixel.

params.name: arnold:global:GI_diffuse_samples
params.label: Diffuse
params.help: Diffuse rays for each camera ray (squared).

params.name: arnold:global:GI_specular_samples
params.label: Specular
params.help: Specular rays for each camera ray (squared).

params.name: arnold:global:GI_transmission_samples
params.label: Transmission
params.help: Transmission rays for each camera ray (squared).

params.name: arnold:global:GI_sss_samples
params.label: SSS
params.help: Subsurface scattering samples (squared).

params.name: arnold:global:GI_volume_samples
params.label: Volume Indirect
params.help: Indirect samples in volumes (squared).

params.name: arnold:global:indirect_specular_blur
params.label: Indirect Specular Blur
params.help: Blurs sharp specular reflections seen by indirect rays (after the first bounce): fewer caustic fireflies.

params.name: arnold:global:low_light_threshold
params.label: Low Light Threshold
params.help: Light samples whose contribution is below this are skipped: faster, a little darker.

params.name: arnold:global:dielectric_priorities
params.label: Nested Dielectrics
params.help: Glass inside water and the like: the interfaces between transmissive objects by their priorities.

params.name: arnold:global:sss_use_autobump
params.label: Use Autobump in SSS
params.help: Displacement's autobump on subsurface scattering too (slower).

params.name: arnold:global:enable_adaptive_sampling
params.label: Enable
params.help: Spend more camera samples where the image is noisy, up to Max. Camera (AA).

params.name: arnold:global:AA_samples_max
params.label: Max. Camera (AA)
params.help: The most camera samples (squared) adaptive sampling may take.

params.name: arnold:global:AA_adaptive_threshold
params.label: Adaptive Threshold
params.help: Noise below which a pixel is done. Lower is cleaner and slower.

params.name: arnold:global:AA_sample_clamp
params.label: Max Value
params.help: The brightest a camera sample may be: clamps fireflies. Arnold's default, 1e30, clamps nothing; 10 is a usual start when fireflies show.

params.name: arnold:global:AA_sample_clamp_affects_aovs
params.label: Affect AOVs
params.help: Clamp the AOVs as well as the beauty.

params.name: arnold:global:indirect_sample_clamp
params.label: Indirect Max Value
params.help: The brightest an indirect sample may be: clamps fireflies from bounced light, keeping highlights seen directly.

params.name: arnold:global:GI_total_depth
params.label: Total
params.help: The most bounces of any kind a path may take.

params.name: arnold:global:GI_diffuse_depth
params.label: Diffuse
params.help: Diffuse bounces.

params.name: arnold:global:GI_specular_depth
params.label: Specular
params.help: Specular bounces.

params.name: arnold:global:GI_transmission_depth
params.label: Transmission
params.help: Transmission bounces.

params.name: arnold:global:GI_volume_depth
params.label: Volume
params.help: Indirect bounces in volumes.

params.name: arnold:global:auto_transparency_depth
params.label: Transparency Depth
params.help: How many transparent surfaces a ray goes through.

params.name: arnold:global:max_subdivisions
params.label: Max Subdivisions
params.help: The most subdivision iterations any mesh may take.

params.name: arnold:global:texture_max_memory_MB
params.label: Texture Cache (MB)
params.help: The most memory the texture cache may use.

params.name: arnold:global:texture_auto_generate_tx
params.label: Auto-generate TX
params.help: Make a .tx (mipmapped, tiled) beside each texture that has none, before rendering with it: a long first render, quick ones after. Off in Imago: on a farm every machine would make the same ones at once; xms --headless scene.xms --tx makes them once.

params.name: arnold:global:texture_use_existing_tx
params.label: Use Existing TX
params.help: Read a .tx beside a texture in its place when there is one.

params.name: arnold:global:texture_automip
params.label: Auto-mipmap
params.help: Mipmap textures that are not, in memory, as they are read.

params.name: arnold:global:texture_accept_unmipped
params.label: Accept Unmipped
params.help: Render with textures that have no mipmaps (else they are an error).

params.name: arnold:global:render_device
params.label: Render Device
params.help: Render on the CPU or the GPU.

params.name: arnold:global:threads
params.label: Threads
params.help: 0: every core. Negative: every core but that many.

params.name: arnold:global:bucket_size
params.label: Bucket Size
params.help: Width and height of the tiles the image is rendered in, in pixels.

params.name: arnold:global:bucket_scanning
params.label: Bucket Scanning
params.help: The order buckets are rendered in.

params.name: arnold:global:abort_on_error
params.label: Abort on Error
params.help: Stop the render at the first error (a missing texture, a bad shader).

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_motion_blur
params.label: Motion Blur
params.help: Render without motion blur.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_dof
params.label: Depth of Field
params.help: Render without depth of field.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_subdivision
params.label: Subdivision
params.help: Render meshes without subdividing them.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_displacement
params.label: Displacement
params.help: Render without displacement.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_bump
params.label: Bump
params.help: Render without bump mapping.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_smoothing
params.label: Smoothing
params.help: Render meshes without smooth normals.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_textures
params.label: Textures
params.help: Render without reading textures.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_shaders
params.label: Shaders
params.help: Render with the default shader on everything.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_lights
params.label: Lights
params.help: Render without lights.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_shadows
params.label: Shadows
params.help: Render without shadows.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_atmosphere
params.label: Atmosphere
params.help: Render without atmosphere volumes.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_sss
params.label: SSS
params.help: Render without subsurface scattering.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_operators
params.label: Operators
params.help: Render without Arnold operators.

params.name: arnold:global:ignore_imagers
params.label: Imagers
params.help: Render without imagers (denoisers, tonemapping).
